title: Check how people are portrayed
statement: Review generated text and pictures for stereotyped or insensitive portrayals of people.
detail: Line-level review of a generated article flagged a sentence that singled out a group's performance skills as repeating a bias the group still faces, and asked for it to be rephrased (`icloud-work/k_12_social_studies/ap_files/Articles Tracker.xlsx`, sheet 'Sheet9', cell C15). Review of another article flagged a generated illustration of a slave ship with people on it as likely to be seen as insensitive, and asked for a more symbolic image or another subject from the topic (sheet 'APUSH Articles', cell M12). Show an atrocity through a symbolic image or another part of the topic, not a generated realistic scene with people in it.
against: Only two instances were recorded and no systematic check existed, so how often this happens is unknown.

evidence.quote: The focus on musical rhythms and ways of performing alongside farming skills, while not incorrect, suggests that their performance skills made them stand out. Please rephrase this, as this is a bias that African Americans still face today, limiting roles and spheres of influence.

I don't think we should illustrate a slave ship using AI, at least not with people on it. It could be considered by many to be insensitive. I would create an alternate image that's more symbolic or has to do with something else in the topic.
